200.description:
One posting as the portal shows it: title, displayed ID and location, header attributes, body sections, and the JobPosting metadata (posted date, validity, employment type, addresses, salary when published) with the apply link.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apply_url` | string | The portal's apply link; null when the posting is not open to direct application. |
| `attributes` | object[] |  |
| `attribution` | string |  |
| `base_salary` | object |  |
| `date_posted` | string | datePosted from the posting's JobPosting JSON-LD, RFC 3339 as published (iCIMS emits UTC midnight-anchored instants). Null when absent or when the portal emits a request-time placeholder for this date (see source_dates.placeholder). |
| `description_html` | string | Full description HTML from the JSON-LD; null when the page carries none. |
| `direct_apply` | boolean |  |
| `employer` | string |  |
| `employer_url` | string |  |
| `employment_type` | string | schema.org employmentType code as published (FULL_TIME, PART_TIME, ...). |
| `id` | string |  |
| `job_locations` | object[] |  |
| `location` | string | Location as the portal displays it in the header field it labels Location / Job Location / Work Location / City (e.g. US-IL-Chicago); null when no such field is shown. Structured addresses are in job_locations. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Retrieval instant, Unix ms. |
| `occupational_category` | string |  |
| `portal` | string |  |
| `portal_url` | string |  |
| `requisition_id` | string | The portal's displayed ID, read from the header field the portal labels ID / Job ID / Requisition ID / Req # / Competition Number / System ID (e.g. 2026-280026, req28796); null when no such field is shown. The stable identifier is id. |
| `retrieved_at` | string | Retrieval instant, RFC 3339 UTC. |
| `sections` | object[] | The posting body as the page shows it: Overview, Responsibilities, Qualifications, ... |
| `source` | string |  |
| `source_dates` | object | The JSON-LD dates verbatim. Some portals emit placeholders generated at request time (datePosted = now minus two years and/or validThrough = now plus one year, with a millisecond clock reading instead of a midnight-anchored instant). Each date is judged on its own against the retrieval clock (within three days of the anchor and not midnight-anchored, or the two forming the exact three-years-apart pair); placeholder is true when at least one date is such a placeholder, and only the affected normalised field(s) are null instead of a synthetic date. |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `title` | string |  |
| `valid_through` | string | validThrough from the JSON-LD; null when absent or when this date is a request-time placeholder (see source_dates.placeholder). A genuine validThrough is kept even when date_posted is a placeholder. |

sections.text:
Good Shepherd Hospice is seeking a compassionate candidate for a Registered Nurse Case Manager serving patients and their families in Ft. Worth and surrounding communities.
The RN provides nursing assessment, planning and care to maximize the comfort and health of patients and families. The RN responds to all phone calls promptly and appropriately, makes patient visits as necessary and completes after hours admissions and deaths as needed.
Previous experience in hospice, home health, or geriatrics preferred

sections.heading: Responsibilities
sections.html:
• Receives patient assignments from the Patient Care Manager or Case Manager. Initiates communication with attending physicians, hospice staff members and other agencies as needed to coordinate optimal care and use of resources for the patient/family.
  •  Cultivates communication and
sections.text:
Receives patient assignments from the Patient Care Manager or Case Manager. Initiates communication with attending physicians, hospice staff members and other agencies as needed to coordinate optimal care and use of resources for the patient/family.
Cultivates communication and bereavement skills.
Maintains regular communication with the attending physician concerning patient/family care.
Contacts families of new patient assignment, maintains regular communication as requested or desired by family.
Obtains data on physical, psychological, social and spiritual factors that may influence patient/family health status and incorporate that data into the Plan of Care.
Maintains up to date patient records so that problems, plans, actions and goals are accurately and clearly stated and changes are reflected as they occur. Turn paperwork into office as required by Medicare and Good Shepherd Hospice policies and procedures.
Instructs the patient and caregiver:
How to administer medication, recognizing side effects, and adverse reactions.
How to perform personal care and oral hygiene.
How to assist in lifting, moving, ambulation and exercise.
Disaster/Safety Management.
How to prepare for the events preceding death.
Informs the Patient Care Manager of unusual or potentially problematic patient/family issues.
Attends the Hospice team meetings and other patient conferences, including care plan meetings, as deemed necessary by the Patient Care Manager.
Provides appropriate support at time of death.
Shares in providing 24-hour, seven days a week coverage to patients and
families.
Evaluates hospice aides every two weeks.
Evaluate LPN at a minimum of one time per month.
Through individualized studies, learn and develop understanding of hospice philosophy.
Become proficient in pain management through individualized reading, in services or seminars.
All other task assigned

sections.heading: Qualifications
sections.html:
1. Registered Nurse currently licensed in the state in which the care is provided. 
  2. Previous experience in hospice, home health, geriatrics or general medical/surgical nursing. 
  3. Demonstrated commitment to the hospice philosophy of care.
sections.text:

category_id.description: Category option id from facets.categories (searchCategory). Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,12}$.

keyword_relation.description:
Match all keywords (default) or any.

Provider reference: allowed values ["all", "any"].

location.description: Location option id from facets.locations (searchLocation), e.g. -12789-Chino.

page.description:
1-based page; pass next_page back here.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 200; default 1.

portal.description: Subdomain of the employer's iCIMS career site, i.e. the <portal> in https://<portal>.icims.com/jobs/search (e.g. careers-primehealthcare, careers-usu, service-princeton). Pattern: ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,62}$.

The Unit Secretary is an unlicensed person who performs indirect care in the department setting. Facilitates the communication needs of the department. Able to assist nursing staff for duties involving indirect patient care.
